criteria.description: Sticky bar, always-visible toggle, fullscreen panel open/close, desktop bar disclosure hover/click/keyboard/Escape/outside/destination close, breakpoint reset, and JS-disabled dual destination exposure all reach documented states

Exactly one brand; four bar entries (3 plain + 1 disclosure); three title-only bar destinations; eight large panel links; one featured heading; two article cards; one view-all control; one contact link; five socials; one named toggle; one dropdown chevron; one view-all chevron — no duplicate close icons or invented rails

Desktop: logo-left, centered four bar entries, end toggle, absolute dropdown; mobile: logo+toggle only until fullscreen opens with stacked large links, featured rail, and footer strip; single landmark without nested nav
Codex reviewed fresh desktop and mobile captures against the reference brief
